svg.title: Who bears the cost of care?
svg.desc: At home : Martineau finds different living conditions under one roof. In a county jail : Dix shows public money paying for confinement without treatment. Before the legislature : A state hospital would redistribute responsibility for care.

g.text: Who bears the cost of care?
Martineau finds different living conditions under one roof.
Dix shows public money paying for confinement without treatment.
A state hospital would redistribute responsibility for care.
